name: MergeLines
description: Arbitrate two feeders that share one outfeed: line A first, one box at a time.

local.name: Active
local.comment: Memory: the line has been started

local.name: Seen
local.comment: The box of the grant has been seen in the zone

local.name: LoadedA
local.comment: Counts the boxes loaded on feeder A

local.name: LoadedB
local.comment: Counts the boxes loaded on feeder B

local.name: Merged
local.comment: Counts the boxes that have left the zone

local.name: LoadedAQ
local.comment: LoadedA.Q: three boxes loaded on A

local.name: LoadedBQ
local.comment: LoadedB.Q: three boxes loaded on B

local.name: MergedQ
local.comment: Merged.Q: all six boxes have left

inputs.name: WaitA
inputs.comment: EyeA.detect: a box waits at the blade of feeder A

inputs.name: WaitB
inputs.comment: EyeB.detect: a box waits at the blade of feeder B

inputs.name: Zone
inputs.comment: EyeZone.detect: a box is on the outfeed past the merge

outputs.name: EmitA
outputs.comment: EmitterA.emit: put one box on feeder A

outputs.name: EmitB
outputs.comment: EmitterB.emit: put one box on feeder B

outputs.name: HoldA
outputs.comment: BladeA.extend: the blade holds feeder A while true

outputs.name: HoldB
outputs.comment: BladeB.extend: the blade holds feeder B while true

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: DoneLight.lit: lit when all six boxes have left
